claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 2 body text clearly read 'Canon EOS 800D', not Sony.
Photo 0 and Photo 2 show 'Canon EOS 800' body text and lens barrel marked 'Canon EF-S 18-55mm'.
No UK import sticker, serial plate, or country-of-origin marking visible in any photo; cosmetic 'neatness' not assessable from given angles.

risks.risk: Shutter count / real usage history unknown
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-check app or menu display

risks.risk: Sensor or internal condition (dust, fungus, corrosion)
risks.proof: Clear photo of sensor with lens removed, and a test shot of a white/blue sky

risks.risk: Power-on and core functionality (AF, buttons, LCD hinge) unverified
risks.proof: Short video clip showing camera powering on, LCD flipping out, AF focusing, and menu navigation

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, strap) not confirmed
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out together with the camera
risks.if_unproven: price as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Lens internal condition (scratches, fungus, haze) not shown with cap off
risks.proof: Close-up photo of lens elements front and rear with cap removed, lit at an angle

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch between seller's words and photographic evidence raises authenticity doubt
risks.proof: Clear photo of serial number plate and matching purchase/warranty document
risks.if_unproven: treat listing as unverified identity, do not price until resolved

proof_requests: Photo of serial number plate (usually under the lens mount or battery door)
Video of camera powering on, autofocus engaging, and LCD screen operating
Photo of sensor with lens detached
Photo of all included accessories together
Close-up of lens glass front and rear with cap off
Any UK purchase receipt, warranty card, or import documentation
response.reason: The seller's claim that the brand is Sony directly contradicts the witness's clear reading of 'Canon EOS 800' on the body in two photos, a core identity mismatch serious enough to suspect a misrepresented or swapped listing.
